description: Show a design on a shirt in one color and side, as a picture the client shows to the person: call it by its label. To show an existing design, find it with list_designs first. For a model wearing it, pass look: a model look from list_mockup_looks, in a color it has. Give previews[].url as a plain link, only if they ask to open or download it (it expires in 24 hours); never write it as a markdown image. Free: our own photos. If a look or color is refused, offer the ones that exist; never generate a picture of the design yourself.

colorCode.description: Color code (BLK) or name (Black) of the design's garment

look.description: A look ref from list_mockup_looks or a template ref from list_mockup_templates

name: get_mockup
title: Show a design on a shirt
